body:
I accept the semantic-audio-end clock and reject an unqualified 'immediate hide' promise.

Settled latency contract:
• Before execution, two expert annotators mark the acoustic endpoint at which a claim/question becomes semantically sufficient to retrieve grounded evidence; disagreements are adjudicated. This is t0.
• t1 is first eligible candidate visibly rendered in Console. Release metric is end-to-end t1-t0 p95 <=5.0s over the frozen corpus/network profile. Timed-out, abstained-on-answerable, stale-slide, and errored events count as failures, not censored samples.
• STT-final->render and component timings are diagnostics only. Summed component p95s are never offered as end-to-end proof.
• 'Related' means expert-labelled claim-supporting or Q&A-actionable with direct source grounding; merely topical results fail.
• Partial STT may prewarm retrieval but cannot establish eligibility or public state.

Disconnect challenge/ruling:
A Stage cannot know about a silent partition at the instant it occurs, so 'immediately on WSS loss' is physically undecidable until close/error/lease expiry. Specify a server-issued display lease for each LIVE_VERIFIED card instead:
1) Lease TTL <=3s, refreshed over WSS only while card remains published/current and controller/session is authoritative.
2) Stage hides the card synchronously on explicit socket close/error, retract tombstone, slide-stale event, controller-epoch change, or lease expiry—whichever occurs first.
3) Heartbeat/lease configuration must bound silent-partition exposure to <=3s under the declared timer-throttling/display environment; test cable/network cut and background throttling. If that bound cannot be demonstrated, LIVE_VERIFIED public display is blocked.
4) Once hidden for loss/expiry, only a fresh authoritative snapshot with a new/current lease may reveal it; queued client state cannot resurrect it.
5) Connected accepted retract->ordered tombstone->hidden p95 <=500ms. Offline 'anytime retract' is not claimed.
6) CURATED_PREAPPROVED may remain during loss only if its deck version, slide binding, local expiry, rights/DLP policy explicitly permit offline persistence; otherwise it follows the same lease.
7) Show a small degraded/offline indicator without retaining the unsafe dynamic claim. Avoid full-screen flicker; only the dynamic card disappears.

This is preferable to both indefinite freeze (unsafe/retract fiction) and literal instant hide (unmeasurable). It provides a testable maximum exposure window.

Other forks accepted: human approval controls publication; SUPPORTED means eligible only; separate-device Console is secure default for both topologies under strict no-private-pixel; high-impact medical/legal/financial claims excluded; numeric/date/entity errors are critical-zero. Full application contract requires a supervised, feature-flagged path for eligible live candidates to traverse approval into public output—private-only is an intermediate pilot, not completion.
summary: Audio clock accepted; disconnect behavior made bounded
